objective: Reduce cost of complete selected decode test qualification without omitting tests or claiming release/runtime parity from a diagnostic profile
requirements: Use one immutable source/dependency/toolchain/fixture snapshot for both profiles; source drift refuses comparison.
Keep exact same five decoded-feature test targets and complete per-binary inventory; no testname filters or renamed success scope.
Compare declared development/test build profile with diagnostic same-crate LTO disabled; do not change repository default/release profiles based on sample alone.
Capture raw child CPU/user/system before and after, walltime and per-compiler physicalfootprint separately from library runtime RSS/MemoryBudget.
First validate a pilot pair, then alternating fresh-process pairs with identical cache policy if feasible; preserve all failures and compiler outputs.
Avoid duplicate/restarted current jobs. Start controlled comparison after existing owned gates complete and resources are available.
Require complete test inventory/results equality and final source/dependency hashes before retaining any build-profile change.
No compiler-profile result establishes model quality, runtime speedup, fullRoot source parity, hardRSS or all12goal completion.
candidate: Diagnostic compiler profile only; same-crate LTO disabled, all test targets preserved
scope: Future captured-source build-performance experiment only. Not executed, no speed/memory reduction claimed. Existing currentRoot compiler remains live; known Root source drift means its partial elapsed/CPU sample is not a same-source A/B baseline.
